name: menegass / Guigui acoustic drum set
scope: Only the 17 Guigui drum kit files mapped to menegass Freesound IDs 100051 through 100067. No other Sonic Pi samples or code included.
notes: Sonic Pi code licenses do not govern these CC0 audio assets.

Eight original per-file CC0 pages were independently retrieved; nine are supported by pinned official Sonic Pi CC0 declaration plus per-file author mapping, without independent current license readback. No contradictory license found within the selected set.
drum_cymbal_hard/soft are ride hits, not crash.
drum_cymbal_pedal maps to author label Half Cymbal; do not promise pedal/chick without audition.
Source hashes identify exact Sonic Pi FLAC, not the original Freesound WAV.
File labels hi/mid/low are articulations, not verified concert MIDI pitches.
Sample durations and decoded sizes are from FLAC STREAMINFO, not a completed decoder check.
